title: The Palace Guide
idiom: illuminated manuscript crossed with woodcut — the guide that builds the place it describes
hero_prompt: A wide darkened backdrop in the register of a medieval illuminated manuscript crossed with a woodcut — a large open book lies flat at center, but its two facing pages are not text: they unfold and rise into a hand-drawn architectural floor-plan, corridors and vaulted chambers of a palace growing directly out of the paper as if the guide is building the place it describes. Warm gold-leaf and deep ink, decorative border vignettes of rooms, a single gender-neutral hand resting at the lower corner of the open book. Upper register veiled dark for legibility. No letters, numerals, words, labels — purely pictorial.
icon_prompt: Bold high-contrast square emblem in black on cream: a simple open-book silhouette whose two pages resolve into a small grid of connected rooms — a floor-plan emerging from the book. Thick woodcut outline, no fine linework, reads at 24px. No letters, numerals, words, labels — purely pictorial.
